WeChat article cover image, subject: 二十万的车凭什么用百万级悬架，方程豹这次把桌子掀了 — 九月十六号那天，我盯着方程豹的发布会看了很久。说实话，看到价格出来的那一瞬间，我脑子里蹦出来的第一个念头是：小米SU7和Model 3的会议室里，今晚大概要加班了。

十八万九千九，你就能买到一台车长超过五米、零百加速跟跑车掰手腕、续航标到九百公里的中大型轿跑。这个价格放在两年前，你只能买到一台合资品牌的紧凑型燃油车，配置表寒酸得让人想哭。现在呢，方程豹直接把桌子掀了。

# 这不是一台普通的比亚. Clean minimalist business cover, solid or subtle gradient background, lots of white space, bold modern Chinese typography as the visual focus, no decorative elements, professional and elegant, editorial magazine style. CRITICAL RULES: Do NOT include any text, letters, Chinese characters, or watermarks in the image. Do NOT generate overly smooth, plastic-like, or hyper-saturated AI-art style. Aim for photorealistic or high-quality editorial illustration style. Natural lighting, natural textures, subtle imperfections are preferred. Avoid shiny/glossy effects. Avoid rainbow gradients. Avoid 3D rendered look. The image should look like it was taken by a professional photographer or designed by a human graphic designer.
